WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT f.`CDSCode`, f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, s.`County`
    FROM frpm AS f
    INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.`CDSCode` = s.`CDSCode`
    WHERE s.`County` = 'Los Angeles'
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `CDSCode`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT f.`CDSCode`
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN frpm f ON r.`CDSCode` = f.`CDSCode`
),
t_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
    FROM t_join
)
SELECT answer FROM t_count;

WITH c_check AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, b.bond_id, b.bond_type
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047'
       OR m.label LIKE '%TR047%'
       OR m.label LIKE 'TR047%'
       OR m.label LIKE '%TR047'
       OR m.label = 'TR047'
       OR m.label LIKE '%TR%047%'
),
c_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.bond_id, b.bond_type
    FROM c_check AS m
    JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047'
),
c_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS double_bonds
    FROM c_bonds
    WHERE bond_type = '='
),
c_total_bonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bonds
    FROM c_bonds
),
final_percent AS (
    SELECT (double_bonds * 100.0 / total_bonds) AS percent
    FROM c_double_bonds, c_total_bonds
)
SELECT percent
FROM final_percent;

    WHERE a.`attribute_name` = 'Speed'
),

    JOIN attribute a ON ha.`attribute_id` = a.id
    WHERE a.`attribute_name` = 'Speed'

    SELECT MIN(min_speed)
    FROM t_publisher_min

    FROM t_join
)

FROM t_final;

    FROM t_join

        COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS total_hamilton_races
     FROM 
        drivers d
        JOIN results rs ON d.driverId = rs.driverId
        JOIN races r ON rs.raceId = r.raceId
     WHERE

    ) AS total_hamilton,
    (SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS first_place_hamilton_races
     FROM 
        drivers d
        JOIN results rs ON d.driverId = rs.driverId
        JOIN races r ON rs.raceId = r.raceId
     WHERE 
        d.surname = 'Hamilton'
        AND r.year >= 2010
        AND rs.position = 1
    ) AS first_place;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId
    FROM races AS r
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId
    FROM c_cols r
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId
    FROM c_rows r
),
c_agg AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_races
    FROM t_join
),
c_final AS (
    SELECT total_races, 10 AS num_years
    FROM c_agg
)
SELECT (total_races / num_years) AS annual_average
FROM c_final;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.PLT, l.ALB
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, l.PLT, l.ALB, e.Diagnosis
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
),
t_rows AS (
    SELECT ID, ALB
    FROM t_join
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND SEX = 'F' AND PLT > 400
),
final_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(ALB) AS answer
    FROM t_rows
)
SELECT * FROM final_avg;

1201.sql:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Diagnosis
    FROM Patient AS p
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Diagnosis
    FROM c_cols p
    WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN Patient p ON r.ID = p.ID
),
c_filter AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM t_join p
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1980'
),
final_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_women
    FROM c_filter
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
c_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_patients
    FROM c_filter
)
SELECT (total_women * 100.0 / total_patients) AS percentage
FROM final_count, c_total;

),
final_result AS (

    WHERE `buildUpPlayPassing` > avg_buildup
)
SELECT `team_long_name` FROM final_result;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT t.`team_long_name`, ta.`buildUpPlayPassing`, ta.date
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.id
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT `team_long_name`, `buildUpPlayPassing`
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE `date` IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', `date`) = '2012'
),
t_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(`buildUpPlayPassing`) AS avg_buildup
    FROM c_rows
),
t_buildup AS (
    SELECT `team_long_name`, `buildUpPlayPassing`
    FROM c_rows
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT `team_long_name`
    FROM t_buildup
    WHERE `buildUpPlayPassing` > (SELECT avg_buildup FROM t_avg)
)
SELECT * FROM final_result;

WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, t.`Price`, t.`Amount`
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`
    FROM c_cols t
    WHERE t.`Price` IS NOT NULL AND t.`Amount` IS NOT NULL
),
t_join AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`, c.`Currency`
    FROM c_rows t
    INNER JOIN customers c ON t.`CustomerID` = c.`CustomerID`
),
t_filter AS (
    SELECT t.`CustomerID`
    FROM t_join t
    WHERE t.`Currency` = 'EUR'
)
SELECT AVG(t.`Price` * t.`Amount`) AS average_total_price
FROM transactions_1k AS t
INNER JOIN t_filter f ON t.`CustomerID` = f.`CustomerID`;

    SELECT DISTINCT m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
                   m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11,
                   p.player_name
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_2 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_4 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_5 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_6 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_7 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_8 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_9 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_10 = p.player_api_id OR m.home_player_11 = p.player_api_id
    OR m.away_player_1 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_2 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_3 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_4 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_5 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_6 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_7 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_8 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_9 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_10 = p.player_api_id OR m.away_player_11 = p.player_api_id
),
t_players_attack AS (
    SELECT p.player_name
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'
)
SELECT DISTINCT tpm.player_name
FROM t_players_match tpm
JOIN t_players_attack tpa ON tpm.player_name = tpa.player_name;
